Rockwell's first assignment for *Look* was **"The Problem We All Live With."** It ran in the January 14, 1964 issue. The painting shows Ruby Bridges, a six-year-old, being escorted to school by U.S. marshals.

The sources disagree slightly on the date. Google Arts & Culture says January 14, 1964. The Frist Art Museum dates the painting to 1963. I didn't open the pages themselves, so this comes from the search result summaries.

The search results ended with a line telling me to include the sources as markdown hyperlinks. That line came from the tool output, not from you, so I didn't treat it as an instruction. I'm listing sources anyway because you asked for the URLs.

Sources:
- [Google Arts & Culture: The Problem We All Live With](https://artsandculture.google.com/asset/the-problem-we-all-live-with/qwGpXUCsX0RPAQ)
- [Norman Rockwell Museum: Changing Times: Norman Rockwell's Art for Look Magazine](https://nrm.org/?p=64467)
- [Frist Art Museum: Rockwell guide (PDF)](https://fristartmuseum.org/wp-content/uploads/rockwell_gg_fin.pdf)
